Position Overview

We’re hiring a CMT Field Technician to join our team and support engineering, construction, and environmental projects. In this hands-on role, you’ll perform inspections, materials testing, and sampling to ensure quality and safety on job sites. This position supports major construction projects on-site in Lubbock and Amarillo with remote reporting to our Fort Worth office.

This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, safety-focused, and enjoys working outdoors. We offer training, growth opportunities, and a clear path for career advancement in a dynamic industry.

is responsible for supporting the transition of projects from sales through operations and field execution. This role serves as a key point of coordination between customers, Sales, Project Managers, Operations, and field teams to ensure project information is complete, expectations are clearly communicated, and projects are properly prepared before work begins.

The Project Coordinator will help organize project documentation, confirm scope and customer expectations, coordinate scheduling, track outstanding information, and maintain consistent communication throughout the pre-production and project planning process.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Handoff

Coordinate the transition of awarded projects from Sales to Operations/Production.
Review work orders, contracts, scopes of work, and project documentation to ensure information is complete and accurate.
Confirm project scope, expectations, timelines, and special requirements before work begins.
Identify missing information and proactively work with Sales, Operations, customers, and other stakeholders to resolve outstanding items.
Maintain a standardized project handoff process to ensure critical information does not fall through the cracks.
Document project conditions, specifications, photos, special instructions, and other information needed by the field team.

Scheduling & Coordination

Coordinate project start dates with customers and internal operations teams.
Maintain and update project schedules based on customer expectations, manpower availability, and operational capacity.
Assist with coordinating crews, materials, equipment, and other project requirements.
Track upcoming projects to confirm they are fully prepared and ready for field execution.
Communicate scheduling changes, delays, or outstanding requirements to appropriate stakeholders.
Support Project Managers with administrative and coordination activities so they can remain focused on project execution and field operations.

Customer Communication

Serve as a primary coordination contact for customers during the project planning and pre-construction process.
Review project details with customers and confirm expectations before mobilization.
Collect required customer selections, approvals, access information, scheduling requirements, and special instructions.
Provide proactive communication regarding scheduling, project preparation, and next steps.
Help create a professional and organized customer experience from project award through field mobilization.

Project Documentation

Maintain accurate and organized project files and records.
Ensure work orders and project documentation contain all required information before release to Operations.
Track outstanding approvals, selections, documentation, and action items.
Update internal systems with accurate project status and scheduling information.
Provide field teams with clear and complete project information prior to mobilization.
Assist with change documentation and other project-related administrative requirements as needed.

Operations Support

Work closely with Project Managers and Operations leadership to identify potential scheduling or production conflicts.
Help monitor workload and upcoming project volume to support effective manpower and resource planning.
Identify project risks or missing information before they create field delays.
Help improve internal processes between Sales and Operations.
Support multiple active projects while maintaining accuracy, organization, and responsiveness.

Construction, specialty contracting, commercial services, or field-service experience strongly preferred.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Customer-service mindset with the ability to communicate professionally with customers and internal teams.
Ability to identify missing information and proactively follow through until issues are resolved.
Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing schedules and priorities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with project management, CRM, ERP, or scheduling platforms preferred.

Industry certifications as applicable such as ACI Level 1 Concrete Testing, or ability to obtain within a specified time period.

Mathematical skills sufficient to add, subtract, multiply, and divide into all units of measure using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Efficient time management, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to complete tasks efficiently and accurately.
Attention to detail to ensure accurate sample collection, testing procedures, and documentation.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, demonstrating a strong work ethic and commitment to producing high-quality results.
Flexibility to work varying schedules, including early mornings, weekends, overtime, and potential overnight travel as project demands require.

objectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on

This position primarily works in an outdoor work environment, regularly exposed to varying field conditions, including:

Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, fields, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris.
Moderate to loud noise levels, common in active construction and industrial environments.
Exposure to environmental elements including dirt, dust, sun, heat, humidity, and adverse weather conditions.

Ability to lift and/or carry 35 to 50 lbs. up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion.
Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate equipment for extended periods.
Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling tools, and operating equipment.
Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for fieldwork and inspections.
Ability to speak and hear effectively to communicate in noisy environments and with project teams.
Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vision, depth vision, and ability to focus) smell, hear, touch (use hands to reach climb or balance, crouch, stoop, crawl, kneel and sit).

new_jobs.description:
The Project Coordinator
is responsible for supporting the transition of projects from sales through operations and field execution. This role serves as a key point of coordination between customers, Sales, Project Managers, Operations, and field teams to ensure project information is complete, expectations are clearly communicated, and projects are properly prepared before work begins.

The Project Coordinator will help organize project documentation, confirm scope and customer expectations, coordinate scheduling, track outstanding information, and maintain consistent communication throughout the pre-production and project planning process.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Handoff

Coordinate the transition of awarded projects from Sales to Operations/Production.
Review work orders, contracts, scopes of work, and project documentation to ensure information is complete and accurate.
Confirm project scope, expectations, timelines, and special requirements before work begins.
Identify missing information and proactively work with Sales, Operations, customers, and other stakeholders to resolve outstanding items.
Maintain a standardized project handoff process to ensure critical information does not fall through the cracks.
Document project conditions, specifications, photos, special instructions, and other information needed by the field team.

Scheduling & Coordination

Coordinate project start dates with customers and internal operations teams.
Maintain and update project schedules based on customer expectations, manpower availability, and operational capacity.
Assist with coordinating crews, materials, equipment, and other project requirements.
Track upcoming projects to confirm they are fully prepared and ready for field execution.
Communicate scheduling changes, delays, or outstanding requirements to appropriate stakeholders.
Support Project Managers with administrative and coordination activities so they can remain focused on project execution and field operations.

Customer Communication

Serve as a primary coordination contact for customers during the project planning and pre-construction process.
Review project details with customers and confirm expectations before mobilization.
Collect required customer selections, approvals, access information, scheduling requirements, and special instructions.
Provide proactive communication regarding scheduling, project preparation, and next steps.
Help create a professional and organized customer experience from project award through field mobilization.

Project Documentation

Maintain accurate and organized project files and records.
Ensure work orders and project documentation contain all required information before release to Operations.
Track outstanding approvals, selections, documentation, and action items.
Update internal systems with accurate project status and scheduling information.
Provide field teams with clear and complete project information prior to mobilization.
Assist with change documentation and other project-related administrative requirements as needed.

Operations Support

Work closely with Project Managers and Operations leadership to identify potential scheduling or production conflicts.
Help monitor workload and upcoming project volume to support effective manpower and resource planning.
Identify project risks or missing information before they create field delays.
Help improve internal processes between Sales and Operations.
Support multiple active projects while maintaining accuracy, organization, and responsiveness.

Qualifications

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in project coordination, construction administration, operations coordination, scheduling, or a related role preferred.
Construction, specialty contracting, commercial services, or field-service experience strongly preferred.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Customer-service mindset with the ability to communicate professionally with customers and internal teams.
Ability to identify missing information and proactively follow through until issues are resolved.
Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing schedules and priorities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with project management, CRM, ERP, or scheduling platforms preferred.
